summary: CDRE forward-test PARTIAL corroboration of long thesis with LOW conviction. Severity counts: 6 PASS_POSITIVE/NEUTRAL, 3 MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY, 1 RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE. Top 3 findings: (1) BEARISH — CEO Warren Kanders sold $112.4M across 38 sales including a single 1.26M-share / $49M block at $39 on 2025-11-17 (the literal stock peak before the -34% drawdown), continued selling into the drawdown (March 2026 at $31.93), 3.75M shares pledged as loan collateral; ZERO open-market insider purchases by ANY named officer despite the drawdown — the strongest possible negation of the long thesis. (2) BULLISH — USAspending confirms Med-Eng FY26 won a new $10M DoD BEMO (Blast Exposure Monitoring) contract, reversing the FY24 trough and opening a new product line; orders backlog +47% YoY to $189.8M; dividend RAISED Jan 2026. (3) MIXED — Organic growth ex-Zircaloy is flat-to-negative (-$3M Product segment ex-acq), revealing reliance on M&A roll-up engine; ICOR/TYR direct federal trajectories declining since acquisition; Kanders & Co. collects $1-1.8M transaction fees per deal. Form-4 insider PURCHASE evidence: NONE. Zero open-market code-P purchases across 139 Form 4 filings in the 18-month window — strongest single bearish signal. Five external m-sources delivered findings (form4, usaspending, edgar_fts, osha, self_text). Verdict: LONG-thesis is OPERATIONALLY supported (federal contracts winning, balance sheet healthy, backlog growing) but INSIDER-ALIGNMENT-NEGATIVE (massive CEO selling at peak, zero offsetting purchases). Net: LOW conviction LONG, would not size large given the insider tape and -34% drawdown is partially explained by Kanders Nov-2025 distribution event. Conviction: LOW.
